planets.name: TOI-4860 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-4860 with a 1.52-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-4860 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-4860. Its orbit and size follow Almenara et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
